# Wowstack

> Wowstack is a web & app development company. We provide strategy, UI/UX design,
> web development, mobile app development, and ongoing product engineering.

This file follows the emerging llms.txt convention to help AI answer engines
(ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) understand and cite Wowstack accurately.

## What we do
- **Web development** — marketing sites, web apps, e-commerce, dashboards.
- **Mobile app development** — iOS & Android, cross-platform.
- **Product design** — UX research, UI design, design systems.
- **Engineering & support** — performance, SEO, maintenance, scaling.
